```{r wins bets}

make_wins_table <- function(
    data,
    default_sorted,
    direction = NULL,
    division_column = "division",
    team_column = "team",
    height = 700
) {
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Column names
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  columns <- names(data)
  
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Create column definitions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  column_defs <- setNames(
    
    lapply(
      
      columns,
      
      function(column) {
        
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Column label
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        label <- labelled::var_label(
          data[[column]]
        )
        
        if (is.null(label)) {
          
          label <- column
          
        }
        
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Identify column types
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        # is_conc <- grepl(
        #   "_conc",
        #   column,
        #   ignore.case = TRUE
        # )
        # 
        # is_pred <- grepl(
        #   "pred_",
        #   column,
        #   ignore.case = TRUE
        # )
        # 
        # is_probability <- grepl(
        #   "prop_",
        #   column,
        #   ignore.case = TRUE
        # )
        # 
        # is_edge <- grepl(
        #   "edge|draft_value",
        #   column,
        #   ignore.case = TRUE
        # )
        # 
        # is_rank_adp_fin <- grepl(
        #   "rank_mod|adp|pred_rank_med|rank_vor",
        #   column,
        #   ignore.case = TRUE
        # )
        
        is_feature <- !is.null(direction) &&
          column %in% names(direction)
        
        is_bet_side <- grepl(
          "bet_side",
          column,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
        
        is_wins <- grepl(
          "_wins",
          column,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Alignment
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        is_center <- column %in% c(
          "team",
          "division",
          "pred_wins_calib",
          "dk_wins",
          "bet_side",
          "bet_odds"
        )
        
        is_center_header <- is_center
        
        base_style <- list(
          whiteSpace = "normal",
          lineHeight = "1.2",
          padding = "8px 6px",
          textAlign = "center"
        )
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Determine color direction
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        column_direction <- "higher"
        
        if (is_feature) {
          
          column_direction <- direction[[column]]
          
        }
        
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Determine widths
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        if (column == division_column) {
          
          column_width <- 120
          
        } else if (column == team_column) {
          
          column_width <- 70
          
        } else if (is_bet_side) {
          
          column_width <- 130
          
        }else if (is_wins) {

          column_width <- 120

        } else {
          
          column_width <- 110
          
        }
        
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Sticky columns
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        is_division <- column == division_column
        is_team <- column == team_column
        
        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Base column definition
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        column_definition <- colDef(

          name = label,
        
          minWidth = column_width,
        
          width = column_width,
        
          align = if (is_division) "left" else "center",
          
          sticky = if (
            is_division | is_team
          ) {
            "left"
          } else {
            NULL
          },
        
          style = base_style,
        
          headerStyle = list(
            whiteSpace = "normal",
            textAlign = "center",
            lineHeight = "1.2",
            padding = "8px 6px"
          )
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Feature columns
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        if (is_feature) {
          
          column_definition <- colDef(
            
            name = label,
            
            style = function(value) {

              c(
                base_style,
            
                make_style(
                  data = data,
                  column = column,
                  direction = column_direction
                )(value)
              )
            
            },
            
            minWidth = column_width,
            
            width = column_width,
        
            align = if (is_division) "left" else "center",
            
            sticky = if (
              is_division | is_team
            ) {
              "left"
            } else {
              NULL
            },
            
            headerStyle = list(
              whiteSpace = "normal",
              textAlign = "center",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px"
            )
          )
        }
        
        if (is_wins) {
          
          column_definition <- colDef(
            
            name = label,
            
            style = function(value) {

              c(
                base_style,
            
                make_style(
                  data = data,
                  column = column,
                  direction = column_direction
                )(value)
              )
            
            },
            
            minWidth = column_width,
            
            width = column_width,
        
            align = if (is_division) "left" else "center",
            
            sticky = if (
              is_division | is_team
            ) {
              "left"
            } else {
              NULL
            },
            
            headerStyle = list(
              whiteSpace = "normal",
              textAlign = "center",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px"
            )
          )
        }
        
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Bet side columns
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        
        if (is_bet_side) {
          
          column_definition <- colDef(
            
            name = label,
            
            minWidth = column_width,
            width = column_width,
            
            align = "center",
            
            style = function(value) {
              
              style <- base_style
              
              if (value == "Bet Over") {
                style <- c(
                  style,
                  list(
                    color = "white",
                    backgroundColor = "#1a9850",
                    fontWeight = "bold"
                  )
                )
              }
              
              if (value == "Bet Under") {
                style <- c(
                  style,
                  list(
                    color = "black",
                    backgroundColor = "#d73027",
                    fontWeight = "bold"
                  )
                )
              }
              
              style
            },
            
            headerStyle = list(
              whiteSpace = "normal",
              textAlign = "center",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px"
            )
          )
        }
        

        
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        # Division column
        # ------------------------------------------------------
        
        if (is_division) {
          
          column_definition <- colDef(
            
            name = label,
            
            minWidth = column_width,
            
            width = column_width,
        
            align = if (is_division) "left" else "center",
            
            sticky = "left",
            
            style = list(
              whiteSpace = "nowrap",
              fontWeight = "bold",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px",
              backgroundColor = "#1e1e1e"
            ),
            
            headerStyle = list(
              whiteSpace = "normal",
              textAlign = "left",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px",
              backgroundColor = "#2b2b2b",
              color = "#ffffff",
              zIndex = 10
            )
          )
        }
        
        # Team column
        if (is_team) {
          
          column_definition <- colDef(
            
            name = label,
            
            minWidth = column_width,
            
            width = column_width,
        
            align = if (is_division) "left" else "center",
            
            sticky = "left",
            
            style = list(
              whiteSpace = "nowrap",
              textAlign = "center",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px",
              backgroundColor = "#1e1e1e"
            ),
            
            headerStyle = list(
              whiteSpace = "normal",
              textAlign = "center",
              lineHeight = "1.2",
              padding = "8px 6px",
              backgroundColor = "#2b2b2b",
              color = "#ffffff",
              zIndex = 10
            )
          )
        }        
        
        # Return column definition
        column_definition
        
      }
    ),
    
    columns
  )
  
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Create reactable
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  reactable(
    
    data,
    
    class = "wins-table-dark",
    
    searchable = TRUE,
    
    filterable = TRUE,
    
    sortable = TRUE,
    
    striped = FALSE,
    
    highlight = TRUE,
    
    bordered = FALSE,
    
    fullWidth = TRUE,
  
    height = height,
    
    defaultPageSize = 400,
    
    defaultSorted = default_sorted,
    
    defaultSortOrder = "asc",
    
    defaultColDef = colDef(
      
      headerStyle = list(
        whiteSpace = "normal",
        textAlign = "center",
        lineHeight = "1.2",
        padding = "8px 6px"
      ),
        
      style = list(
        whiteSpace = "normal",
        lineHeight = "1.2",
        padding = "8px 6px"
      )
    ),
    
    columns = column_defs,
  
    theme = reactableTheme(
      style = list(
        overflow = "visible"
      )
    )
  )
}

make_style <- function(
    data,
    column,
    direction = "higher"
) {
  
  values <- data[[column]]
  
  is_probability <- grepl(
    "prop_",
    column,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
  
  domain <- if (is_probability) {
    
    c(0, 1)
    
  } else {
    
    range(
      values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  pal <- scales::col_numeric(
    
    palette = c(
      "#d73027",
      "#fee08b",
      "#1a9850"
    ),
    
    domain = domain,
    
    reverse = direction == "lower"
  )
  
  function(value) {
    
    scaled_value <- if (
      direction == "higher"
    ) {
      
      (value - domain[1]) /
        diff(domain)
      
    } else {
      
      (domain[2] - value) /
        diff(domain)
    }
    
    list(
      
      backgroundColor = pal(value),
      
      color = ifelse(
        scaled_value > 0.70,
        "white",
        "black"
      ),
      
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
  }
}

make_wins_table(
  
  data = df_wins_bet,
  
  default_sorted = "division",
  
  height = 700

)
```
